implementation_scope: Current requested source milestones; separate hardware, performance and conditional later research gates remain open.

32.additions: Prepared ordered-basis native transfers and exact conversion/lift; owned packet identity, proof, budget and publication.

43.additions: Stream-bound builtins/CK/rocWMMA/hipBLASLt and explicit caller-graph bindings using existing prepared completion/lifetime machinery.

45.additions: Explicit gfx942 FNUZ and gfx1201 OCP four/three-product FP8 recipes, certificates, target probes and matched collector inputs.

48.additions: Certified one-level rank48 rational coefficient execution on odd channels, classical even-channel preservation and direct/matrix subproducts.

50.additions: M/N, block-cyclic 2-D output and exact K-fragment partitioning in CPU/mock and real HIP owner, complete partial gather and integer modular reduction.

54.additions: Optional isolated Linux AArch64 I8MM/SMMLA research owner with OS admission, retained B, exact range and transactional publication.

63.additions: Prime-channel five-product Gram owner with certified skew transforms, classical composite fallback and real matrix subproducts.

67.additions: Optional installed DLPack1.2 adapter and real installed HIP producer/GEMM/consumer examples with managed ownership.

repairs: CPU-only builds guard hipBLASLt cleanup references when the optional provider is absent (b5a381c, before testing).
New distributed mock fixtures explicitly publish after complete delivery and acknowledgement.
Operation inventory and bounded/finite fixtures match implemented capture support and existing CK/prime-field admission.
Expanded benchmark catalogue count is 2109; concurrent immutable publishers accept only independently verified identical destination bytes after Windows replacement denial.
AUTO smoke accepts strictly validated censored timing diagnostics without reporting them as event timings.
RDNA4 FP8 operand map matches the official contiguous-eight-byte policy; encoder coverage includes integer16.
limits: No benchmark campaign, residue-dot harness or new speedup collection was resumed.
Linux multi-GPU peer/pinned transports, Instinct/CDNA, RDNA4 FP8, AMX and AArch64 I8MM execution remain hardware qualification gates.
One-device HIP tests exercise distributed partition and reduction kernels, not real inter-device transport or scaling.
FP8 certificates are conditional instruction-model checks; emitted opcodes do not prove actual accumulator behavior.
Real device-fault/failed-drain recovery, physical overlap/traffic/resource counters and profitable measured routing remain open.
FP4/FP6/dynamic/mixed-scale contracts and RCCL/multiprocess/multinode/device-initiated M3 transports remain separately gated conditional research extensions.
Experimental-basis library/distributed providers and automatic basis routing remain explicitly unsupported beyond the current CPU/direct-HIP phase.
